long_description:
Perfect—this makes a lot of sense strategically. 🌹

An October 2-day / 1-night Inner Goddess Retreat is ideal as a gateway temple: accessible, welcoming, potent but not overwhelming.

Below is a tweaked version of your retreat language that softens the depth just enough to widen the doorway—while still feeling unmistakably you and Temple Sacred Heart–coded.

You can use this for:

 • Event page

 • Evergreen banner text

 • Social posts

 • Email invites

⸻

✨ INNER GODDESS RETREAT ✨

A Sacred Priestess Gathering

Austin, Texas

Hosted by Aiylah Valkyrie & Takata Ra

Temple Sacred Heart • Inner Goddess Retreats (Nonprofit)

Join us for a beautiful, heart-opening weekend designed to reconnect you with your inner goddess through ritual, movement, nature, and sisterhood.

This 2-Day / 1-Night retreat is a gentle yet powerful initiation into the Temple Sacred Heart experience—perfect for women who feel called to the Sacred Path and are ready to slow down, soften, and remember who they are.

All women, at all stages of their journey, are welcome.

⸻

🌿 THE EXPERIENCE

This retreat is intentionally designed to be accessible, nourishing, and expansive, offering a taste of the deeper priestess work we are known for—without overwhelm.

You’ll be held in a safe, loving container where you can:

 • Rest your nervous system

 • Connect with like-hearted women

 • Experience ceremony in a grounded, embodied way

 • Leave feeling refreshed, inspired, and more deeply connected to yourself

✨ This is not a yoga retreat.

✨ This is not a workshop marathon.

✨ This is a sacred pause—a remembrance.

⸻

✨ WHAT’S INCLUDED

• Gentle Goddess Yoga & Meditation (all levels)

• Opening & Closing Fire Ceremonies

• Water Blessing & Heart Activation

• Sound Healing & Drum Journey

• Sacred Song & Medicine Music

• Ecstatic Dance Journey (soft, embodied, beginner-friendly)

• Time in nature, pool & hot tub

• Spacious free time to journal, rest, connect, or simply be

• Organic vegetarian meal
